record: National Park Service official landmark interpretation
facts: Street curves around its projecting west tower. The present church was built in 1835–1838 and the tower was added later.
Georgian-derived church and steeple, with classical porticoes and Corinthian interior columns.
Mapped upper belfry and steeple height 56 m, with 11 m assigned to the roof needle. These heights are approximate mapping controls.
